notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Soliton.
Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Soliton to become a blue artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Soliton triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
